text: וְכִֽי־תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃ בַּיּ֤וֹם
translation: When you sacrifice a thanksgiving offering to יהוה, sacrifice it so that it may be acceptable in your favor. It shall be

translation: eaten on the same day; you shall not leave any of it until morning: I am יהוה.
parts: הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה

translation: You shall faithfully observe My commandments: I am יהוה. You shall

text: תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל

parts: תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל

translation: people—I יהוה who sanctify you, I who brought you out of the land

text: לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
translation: of Egypt to be your God, I יהוה.

text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙
translation: יהוה spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to the Israelite people

translation: and say to them: These are My fixed times, the fixed times of יהוה,

translation: a sacred occasion. You shall do no work; it shall be a sabbath of יהוה
